crossRefs.note: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

parallels.note: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.
After them all, the woman died.

translations.web: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.
translations.bsb: In this way, none of the seven left any children. And last of all, the woman died.
translations.kjv: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
translations.asv: and the seven left no seed. Last of all the woman also died.
